title: The AI Bubble Is About to Pop
full_monologue: **The AI Bubble Is About to Pop and Nobody Cares**. We’re seeing AI startups valued at billions with no real product, and investors are still throwing money at them. It’s a bubble, and it’s getting bigger. But here’s the thing—most people aren’t paying attention. They’re too busy chasing the next big thing. When the bubble pops, it won’t be a crash, it’ll be a slow burn. And by then, it’ll be too late. So what do you think? Are we already in the bubble, or is it still coming?
